<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample and count the distinct carbon signals that appear in the typical aromatic chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the number of aromatic carbon environments, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
